minor.issue: On this live run the fast chain routed to Groq and returned 10 factors instead of the main-agent's 16-23 observation (which used Gemini). The route works correctly (mode=detail, 3 options incl. main listing + 2 similar), but factor count is provider-dependent. If the desired floor is ≥16, consider strengthening the fast-tier prompt or biasing the chain toward Gemini for detail-pages.
